name: curriculum-bench
description: The calibration bench of the swimmer curriculum's first rung: curriculum-rung1's world, tank, switches and founders as a bench with no search, in the form of leaf-direction-patches-s2-founders-w6. The twenty founders swim curriculum-rung1's exam as they are, eight to a tank, on 32 episodes under its five brains (their own, none, the leaf smell knocked out, a frozen stroke and constant full power), on the recipe seed and exam salt curriculum-rung1 uses, so that each founder's eating, its time to the disc that opens and its share of eating from the discs that open after its first are read on the episodes the rung's winners will be examined on. A draft: the coordinator reads the bench to set the period, the regrowth, the withering and the turn before any arm. The bench has no search, so the rung's search, stop and score are not in it. Its world is curriculum-rung1's, whose description was: D236's switching tank, rung 1: D184's tank of 3,400 m2 (leaf-direction-patches-w6's) with its 31 leaves in two discs of 7 m radius on a ring of 21 m, so that 28 m of bare water lies between the discs at the start and at least 4.9 m between each disc and the glass, and with the discs taking turns being fed. The radius is 7 m in place of D236's draft of 6 m, by the coordinator's calibration of 2026-10-25: over the 520 seeds --check lays, 6 m found no place for a leaf in 64 draws in 3 first deals and in 6 of 1,034 fresh complements, 6.5 m in 2 first deals, and 7 m in none. The margin to the glass, 4.9 m at its least, is under the smell's reach of 6 m, so a leaf near the rim can be smelled from beside the glass; the bench reads whether that matters. The fed disc regrows: a leaf that leaves the living there is replaced 120 s later by a fresh one drawn from the leaf pool. Every 600 s the feeding switches, so at 600 s and 1,200 s of the 1,800 s episode: both old discs wither, each leaf dying at a random second within 300 s and leaving no food, and the disc now fed is laid afresh at an angle on the ring at least 120 degrees from the disc that withered (leaves.patches.switching: period 600, regrowAfter 120, witherOver 300, minimumTurn 120). The world's overrides add, to leaf-direction-patches-w6's, the eating rule of round 62's screen r62cs-w500 (rounds/env-r62cs-w500.ps1 over rounds/env-r62ce.ps1): ContactEating on (D219, D220), BiteTakesStore on (D224) and RemainsWindowSeconds at 500 (D220), with the intake scale at 16 (D227) as D232's screen r62kg runs it, every other mouth dial as the nursery config has it; and the two switches the moving-oasis screen carries: Fluid.ShapedAddedMass on (the fin law, D229) and Development.ReflectMirroredAnchors on (the mirrored joint, D228). D232's gut is not on this branch and joins the eating rule after D232's read; D231's assembly push and D234's mirrored drive are not on this branch either, and stay off. Only food from leaves counts as eaten (Organism.FoodFromLeavesJoules), so a swimmer that bites another is not fed by it. The founders are the twenty of inocula/r59-direction-blades/pool-mixed.tsv, round 59's ten leaf tops (inocula/r59-direction-tops) and the same ten with the round limb replaced by a flat blade of equal volume (D236), as the nursery pool rounds/nursery/pools/39d06aac2d0d0f60.tsv (scripts/reads/curriculum-pool.py makes it), each on body 0 with its own brain. Every other setting is leaf-direction-patches-s2-founders-w6's, whose description was: leaf-direction-patches-s2-founders on round 62's world config format: leaf-direction-patches-s2-founders-w5's config with the 45 tunables the round-62 build added, the 27 coral keys (D194's branching coral; coral.reefShape at Mushroom and its dials at their defaults), development.reflectMirroredAnchors (D228), development.scaleLengthensOnce (D199), feeding.plantsKeepMatter (D206), feeding.plantsKeepOwnFirst (D207), field.corpseHalfLifeSeconds (D212), fluid.shapedAddedMass (D229), mouth.biteDamageScale (D226), mouth.biteTakesStore (D224), mouth.contactEating (D219, D220), mouth.intakeReachFromMouth (D214), mouth.intakeScale, mouth.remainsWindowSeconds (D220), physics.dragLimitAtEveryStep (D196, D199), physics.dragLimitByWeldedBody (D199), world.contactShape (D228), world.matterBurialDesertPerSecond (D190), world.readAcrossSeams (D204) and world.seedOverrides (D192), at their defaults, which leave the world as leaf-direction-patches-s2-founders-w5's. Every other setting as leaf-direction-patches-s2-founders-w5, whose description was: leaf-direction-patches-s2-founders on round 60's world config format: its world config is e6bdb9c74cb48742's with world.matterIslandGlassMarginMetres (D185) at 0, which leaves the tank as it was, and every other setting is leaf-direction-patches-s2-founders's, whose description was: The founders' baseline for D182's patch measures: leaf-direction-patches-s2's exam (its seed, salt, 32 draws and three brains) swum by the ten founders of inocula/r59-direction-tops as they are, eight to a tank, with no search.
